goal: Perl review: taint checks, regular expressions, command execution and error handling.
use: Perl review: taint checks, regular expressions, command execution and error handling. Use when asked to review a Perl script or module.

steps.note: Read the script or module. The version and the modules used.
Check taint. Flag input used in system calls without taint checks.
Check commands. Flag shell execution built from strings.
Check patterns. Flag regular expressions with catastrophic backtracking on input.
Report. Each finding with file and line, severity and the fix.
